messages.author: 2f27e6214b3c8153
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 load error
parts:
To add another layer to this problem -- ggplot2 loads fine when the workspace is entirely empty. However, if there is anything else loaded ggplot2 gives the error below.

I'm working from a fresh R3.0 Windows install and a fresh installs of ggplot2 and all the linked packages.



On Tuesday, April 16, 2013 3:41:17 PM UTC-7, Christopher Aberson wrote:

I'm getting this error pretty regularly well loading ggplot

Error : .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'ggplot2', details:
  call: stats::runif(1)
  error: '.Random.seed' is not an integer vector but of type 'list'
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’

This seems to coincide with the upgrade to R3.0 (I've had problems with 3.0 and 3.0 patched)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 load error
parts:
What happens if you just do runif(1)? The error message suggests that
something is wrong with your .Random.seed.

Hadley
